title: Olympus Protocol Vocabulary
description: Domain vocabulary for OlympusDAO protocol metrics, treasury, and OHM supply concepts.

terms.definition: The native reserve currency token of the Olympus protocol, backed by a diversified treasury of on-chain assets.
Governance OHM — a wrapped, index-adjusted form of sOHM used for governance and cross-chain staking. gOHM price = OHM price * OHM index.
Staked OHM — OHM tokens deposited into the Olympus staking contract. sOHM accrues rebase rewards and is 1:1 redeemable for OHM.
A cumulative multiplier representing total staking rewards accrued since genesis. Used to convert between sOHM and gOHM.
Annual percentage yield for OHM staking, derived from the rebase rate compounded over one year.
All OHM tokens minted and in existence across all supported EVM chains.
OHM tokens accessible to the open market — total supply minus OHM held in the Olympus treasury.
OHM not owned by the protocol or locked in liquidity pools. A measure of truly freely-traded OHM.
OHM tokens backed by liquid treasury assets. Used to compute backing-per-OHM.
OHM locked in protocol-owned liquidity (POL) pools. Counted in total supply but not floating supply.
OHM deposited as collateral in lending protocols. Counted in total supply but not floating supply.
Liquidity pool positions owned directly by the Olympus treasury, pioneered by OlympusDAO. POL eliminates mercenary liquidity and generates trading fees for the protocol.
The total USD value of all assets held in the Olympus treasury, including illiquid and protocol-owned positions.
The USD value of liquid, non-OHM treasury assets. Divided by backed supply to compute liquid backing per OHM.
Total value locked in the Olympus staking contract, denominated in USD.
The Olympus mechanism by which the protocol sells OHM or LP tokens at a discount in exchange for treasury assets, allowing the protocol to grow its treasury.
A periodic supply adjustment that distributes staking rewards to sOHM holders by increasing the sOHM balance proportionally.
The blockchain indexer used by OlympusDAO to index on-chain events and produce 8-hour-cadence metric snapshots stored in an S3-compatible artifact store.
The specific block number selected as the authoritative daily data point for each chain. Used to ensure consistent cross-chain comparisons.
The maximum number of days that can be queried in a single API request. Default is 366 days.
